description: This pie chart illustrates the relative share of the most frequent languages in the dataset, displaying ten distinct language categories represented as slices of varying sizes and colors. The largest segment is labeled “English” at 42.8%, shown in a dark blue. The second largest is “Spanish” at 31.4%, in a lighter blue. Following are “Russian” at 5.7%, “German” at 3.6%, “French” at 2.9%, “Chinese” at 2.5%, “Thai” at 1.9%, “Portuguese (Brazil)” at 1.7%, “Catalan” at 1.6%, and a combined “Other” category at 5.8%, which is visually distinct with a lighter, almost white-blue hue. Each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding language name and percentage value, and the chart includes a legend-like structure where the labels are positioned directly on the chart segments. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest (English) on the left and proceeding clockwise, with the “Other” category occupying the topmost position.
